title: Tables
description: Every table and view in the faa schema and how many rows it has.

list.name: catalog
list.label: Catalog
list.description: The Unity Catalog catalog holding the faa schema. scripts/grafana-provision.sh sets it from databricks.catalog.

panels.title: Tables and views in ${catalog}.faa
panels.description: Counted when the dashboard loads. The list comes from the catalog's information schema, so new tables appear on their own.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE OR REPLACE VARIABLE counts STRING;
SET VAR counts = (
  SELECT concat_ws(" UNION ALL ", array_sort(collect_list(concat(
           "SELECT '", table_name, "' AS `Table`, '", if(table_type = "VIEW", "view", "table"),
           "' AS `Type`, count(*) AS `Rows` FROM `${catalog}`.faa.`", table_name, "`"))))
  FROM ${catalog}.information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = "faa");
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE counts
